note: Nationwide protests + crackdown = pressured (still coercive control).

article.headline: Mass protests erupt across Iranian cities as regime orders crackdown

assignments.reason: Mass protests across multiple cities plus an ordered crackdown signal serious domestic challenge to the regime, but a crackdown also indicates the regime still retains coercive control rather than having lost it outright.

recorded_response.overall_rationale: Nationwide protests met with a state crackdown point to a regime under significant internal pressure, with a meaningful chance of tipping toward instability though not yet collapse.
